headline: "December ECB rate hike may not be enough"
summary: The ECB has raised interest rates twice this year as high energy costs pushed inflation well above its 2.0% target. A further December increase may not be sufficient, according to the report.
why: The European Central Bank sets interest rates for the euro area, shaping euro yields, the euro's value and equity valuations.
original_headline: “Aumento de tasas del BCE de diciembre podría no ser suficiente”
